rules.answer: Under §2.1 Working hours, teaching takes place Monday to Friday between 9:00 and 17:00; weekend classes or slots outside these hours require written approval from the Head of Department.

rules.title: Fixed windows
rules.text: Guest faculty teach only in the availability windows agreed in their appointment letter. These windows are fixed institutional commitments and may not be negotiated away by other faculty members.

rules.answer: Yes, under §4 Maintenance, laboratories are closed for maintenance on the first Saturday of every month.

rules.text: Laboratories are closed for maintenance on the first Saturday of every month.

rules.answer: Under §2.2 Common lunch break, the hour from 13:00 to 14:00 is a common lunch break with no scheduled classes, and only the Dean may grant an exception.

rules.text: The hour from 13:00 to 14:00 is a common lunch break for all students and staff. No lecture, tutorial or practical may be scheduled in this hour. The lunch break cannot be waived by the department; only the Dean may grant an exception.
